issue_title: Cover the allowed-paths invalid-pattern violation in the policy tests
issue_body: checkAllowed reports `one or more patterns invalid` when a pattern does not parse, but no test pins that row. Add test rows for an invalid pattern alone and an invalid pattern beside a valid one.

plan.summary: Add allowed-paths test rows pinning the invalid-pattern violation.

approach.description: Add a TestCheckAllowed row whose only pattern is `[` and assert both the invalid-pattern violation and the files-outside violation.
Add a row with `[` beside `docs/**` and assert the invalid-pattern violation plus no files-outside violation for a docs file.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A test fails if checkAllowed stops reporting an invalid allowed_paths pattern.

false_alarm_examples.note: policy_test.go: the new rows suggest checkAllowed tolerates an invalid pattern.
